job_description:
Descrição da empresa
Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro por meio das inovações tecnológicas de alta qualidade e de serviços que despertam entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. Temos uma promessa sólida para nossos colaboradores: crescemos juntos, gostamos do nosso trabalho e inspiramos uns aos outros. Junte-se a nós e sinta a diferença.



Descrição da vaga
Liderar a implementação do catálogo online interno da Bosch, incluindo o desenvolvimento e a conexão de APIs de busca externa (como a busca de dados por placas de veículos para a página do Brasil).

•Coordenar a extração e atualizações mensais das bases de dados dos catálogos utilizando fluxos de trabalho de Análise de Dados (Data Analytics) (Knime/Python), integrando dados do VitAA e alinhando as entregas com parceiros internos e externos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de Dados no mapeamento da frota circulante, cobertura de número original e lançamentos.

•Atuar como o usuário-chave (Key User) regional para o sistema PIM na América Latina, organizando a classificação do portfólio e atuando como guardião da qualidade das traduções de textos de marketing.

•Coordenar sessões de fotos de produtos com as Business Units (BUs) e fotógrafos, e utilizar ferramentas de infraestrutura (como Azure Storage Explorer) para carregar os ativos de mídia finais no MAM.

•Representar a região em comitês globais de conteúdo digital e de gestão de ativos de mídia.

•Desenhar, programar e implantar agentes de IA inteligentes para otimizar, automatizar e apoiar processos de gestão de dados do Mobility Aftermarket.

•Definir e implementar arquiteturas de software modulares e escaláveis, permitindo a rápida implantação de novos casos de uso em múltiplos domínios.

•Traduzir requisitos de negócios e dores de parceiros (stakeholders) em arquiteturas de sistemas viáveis e implementações técnicas de IA.

•Avaliação de Tecnologias Emergentes: Avaliar continuamente tecnologias de IA emergentes, recomendar aplicações práticas e integrar novas soluções à plataforma APEX.



Qualificações
•Superior Completo.

•Experiência relevante no desenvolvimento de soluções de IA/ML (Inteligência Artificial / Aprendizado de Máquina).

•Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos.

•Experiência anterior em traduzir requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas de IA será considerada um diferencial.

•Inglês: Avançado / Fluente.

•Espanhol intermediário (desejável).

Habilidades Técnicas

•Arquitetura de IA & Arquitetura de Software: Experiência no desenho de arquiteturas de sistemas corporativos, modulares e escaláveis.

•Especialidade no desenvolvimento de fluxos de agentes de IA, engenharia de prompts avançada e orquestração de Grandes Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs).

•Proficiência em Python para desenvolvimento de componentes de software de IA, manipulação de dados e automação de fluxos de trabalho.

•Experiência no desenvolvimento, consumo e integração de APIs RESTful para conectar serviços internos e externos.

•Capacidade de analisar, limpar e enriquecer grandes volumes de dados de produtos (ferramentas como Knime, Pandas ou SQL são altamente valorizadas).

•Capacidade de compreender dores operacionais e arquitetar soluções técnicas de ponta a ponta.

Competências Comportamentais

•Colaboração Multidisciplinar (Cross-functional): Forte habilidade para participar de discussões

técnicas e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com especialistas de dados e equipes de negócios

(Marketing, Vendas, Produto).

•Colaborar com especialistas de negócios para compreender processos, terminologias e lógicas de decisão.

•Identificar e priorizar novos casos de uso de IA com valor de negócio mensurável.

•Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com parceiros de negócios, especialistas de dados e desenvolvedores de software para entregar soluções de IA de ponta a ponta.

Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro por meio das inovações tecnológicas de alta qualidade e de serviços que despertam entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. Descrição da vaga
Role mission


 The position acts as the IT/Product Owner for IBM Integration Platforms within HC/BDO2. In this
role, you drive the global strategy, operation, and modernization of our IBM integration suite (IBM
MQ, ACE, IBM Sterling, and IBM SCBN). Your mission is to secure, standardize, and scale our core
application-to-application (A2A) messaging and critical business-to-business (B2B/EDI) supply chain
integrations. Operating within a hybrid multi-platform landscape, you ensure seamless data flows
across global transactional systems to support business operations and key post-merger integration
(PMI) initiatives.


Core responsibilities

Define the global roadmap and product vision for the IBM integration suite in alignment with our multi-platform strategy. Actively manage and prioritize the product backlog in an agile environment, translating complex business demands and B2B/EDI requirements into actionable user stories.
Establish global integration guidelines, security standards, mapping rules, and partnertemplates.
Ensure compliant, secure, and stable operations for internal messaging and external EDI data flows.
Collaborate closely with Integration Architects, other Platform Owners (such as AIS and SAP CPI), business units, and external supply chain partners to design robust, end-to-end integration patterns.
Oversee platform stability, SLA compliance, and cost-efficiency. Drive the technical modernization and migration from legacy gateways to modern integration patterns while steering external implementation partners and vendors (such as IBM).
 



Qualificações
Expected background and capabilities

Bachelor's degree in information technology, Business, Engineering, or related field
Strong experience as an IT Product Owner, Solution Architect, or Technical Lead in enterprise integration or B2B/EDI platforms, combined with a strong track record in agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and leading international teams or external partner delivery squads.
Strong technical understanding of Microsoft Azure Integration Services (specifically API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Azure Functions). Experience with hybrid integration scenarios (connecting on-premises ERPs like SAP or Oracle to the cloud) is highly beneficial.
Outstanding stakeholder management and negotiation skills to act as a bridge between central IT, global business units (logistics, purchasing, sales), and external partners.
Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Technology Researcher and Designer 2023 - Apresentar

Bosch

In Bosch Brasil's main service unit I treat UX as something teams can practice themselves, not only a specialist craft. I coach colleagues to apply UX methods in their own business work, and I collaborate on global projects that need careful problem framing. Concretely: I helped the Americas reach UX Maturity Level 4 with governance, templates, and training. Worked on CIP CIM dashboards and ServiceNow UX-relevance automation for Global Services. Guided Power Tools tooling from requirements to high-fidelity prototypes with customer check-ins. Built Power BI oversight for projects, resources, and training. Ran qualitative Data Insights on call-center transcripts, using Grounded Theory with Python and Power BI. And I use agentic AI daily in VS Code. I also traveled twice to Germany (2024, 2025), tutor at the SENAI Digital Talent Academy, and trained 100+ people on AI tools with 4.88/5 satisfaction.


Web Developer 2020 - 2022

Bosch

As a Web Developer at Bosch Brasil I delivered front-end work in React within Scrum and Kanban. I brought applied-research habits into day-to-day shipping with the team. The portfolio mixed customer-facing applications and internal tools, so clear interfaces and reliable delivery mattered as much as individual code craft. Collaboration across design, research, and engineering was constant-and where I grew the most.


Digitization Support Analyst (Systems Analysis and Development) 2019 - 2019

Bosch Magyarország

In Budapest I supported Bosch Hungary's Business Excellence Development team by digitizing systems and workflows, mostly in Kanban. Most of the year went into web systems: VS Code, SQL Server, Windows Server with IIS, and Git. VBA in Excel filled gaps where dynamic spreadsheets were the fastest way to stabilize a process. The role sat close to users of internal tools and close to the infrastructure that kept those tools running.


Estagiário 2017 - 2018

Bosch Brasil

As an intern across Continuous Improvement and Internal Communication I provided IT support and built digital tools for both areas. Dynamic Excel workbooks with VBA, often linked to Access, became systems for CIP methodologies and registration tools for internal events. That work led to the Excel macro that took 3rd place at the Bosch Talent Forum 2018.

Formação Acadêmica

Universidade Estadual de Campinas 2023 - 2026

Information and Communication Systems

Master's in Technology: Information and Communication Systems

My thesis measures perceived trust in e-commerce and tests whether AI agents can stand in for people. I defined MQCI, a hierarchical model grounded in ISO/IEC 25000, so Usability, Accessibility, and User Experience compose one Trust score. I built TrustMate to apply it: Vue 3 on the front end, a Python/Flask REST API, and Azure (Static Web Apps, App Service, Azure SQL), prototyped in Figma. With 127 IT students and ChatGPT o3 agents on three e-commerce sites, Shapiro-Wilk rejected normality, so the inference is Mann-Whitney U, Wilcoxon signed-rank, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, run in Python (pandas, SciPy) and reported in Power BI. Agents track people on Trust (agreement 0.83, mean absolute difference 0.07) and are still not interchangeable: stricter on 79% of the leaf attributes, useful as automated triage rather than a replacement. Grade A in every course. Master's approved in September 2026. Diploma scheduled for December 2026.


Unicamp 2015 - 2020

Systems Analysis and Development

Undergraduation

The Systems Analysis and Development curriculum at Unicamp spans entrepreneurship, software engineering, governance, administration, structured programming, and object-oriented programming. Studying there from 2015 to 2020 gave me both the engineering vocabulary and the organizational lens I still use when research meets delivery inside industry.


ETEC Bento Quirino 2023 - 2026

Information Technology

Computer Technician

Technical high school at ETEC Bento Quirino was my first sustained immersion in Information Technology. The curriculum - programming logic, operating systems, software development, database languages, business organization - formed the habits I later expanded at Unicamp. Graduating into that pathway in 2014 made the 2015 university start feel like a continuation rather than a leap into the unknown.

Your tasks
We're looking for a curious, hands-on Automation Experience Designer who is excited to apply automation and AI tools to real business challenges. In this role, you won't just explore new technologies-you'll actively use them to design better processes and help others adopt them with confidence. This is a great opportunity for early-career talent who enjoys building, experimenting, and teaching others how to work more efficiently using modern digital tools.

Job Description:

Analyze & Improve Workflows

Map current processes and identify opportunities where automation or AI can add value.
Evaluate when to use automation vs. when a human-centered approach is more appropriate.
Build & Apply Automation Solutions

Design and develop solutions using RPA and AI tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath, generative AI tools).
Select the right tools for the problem and apply them effectively to streamline work.
Design for the User Experience

Ensure automation solutions are intuitive, usable, and aligned with how people actually work.
Apply human-centered design principles when creating and refining solutions.
Enable & Train Others

Demonstrate how to use automation and AI tools in practical, business-relevant ways.
Lead training sessions (virtual and in-person) and create clear, simple learning materials.
Support teams in adopting new tools and building their own automation capabilities.
Support Project Delivery

Contribute to project planning, timelines, and coordination.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement and scale solutions.
Your profile
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Design, or a related field.
1+ years of experience in process improvement, automation, digital transformation, business analysis, or applying AI and automation tools in a professional, internship, or co-op environment.
Hands-on experience using automation and/or AI tools.
Ability to apply AI tools to solve real problems, not just experiment with them.
Confidence in explaining and demonstrating tools to others in a clear, engaging way.
Understanding of process mapping and workflow improvement.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
A user-first mindset and a natural curiosity for improving how work gets done.
Nice to Have

Experience with tools like Power Automate, UiPath, or similar RPA platforms.
Familiarity with prompt design or using generative AI effectively in workflows.
Exposure to project management concepts or tools.
Contact & additional information
Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.

Additional Information

AI Transformation Owner, Product & Design

Remote, Canada; Remote, United Kingdom; Remote, United States

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.

Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.

You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.

What you'll do

Strategy & Prioritization

  • Own your function's AI strategy, aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.
  • Map how work flows across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?
  • Manage intake of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.
  • Prioritize strategically against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.

Adoption & Change Management

  • Reimagine, not just automate. Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.
  • Drive adoption and change management together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.
  • Coordinate with Enterprise AI to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.
  • Build and bridge the Champion network in your function. Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.

Hands-On Building & Agent Operations

  • Build AI agents using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.
  • Author and iterate on skills files that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.
  • Configure MCP servers and tools, giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.
  • Own your function's fleet of agents. Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.
  • Expect to rebuild. AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.

What you'll bring

Business & Strategic

  • Deep knowledge of your function's operations. You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.
  • Strategic prioritization skills. You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.
  • A product management mindset. You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.
  • Strong communication and influence. You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.
  • Cross-functional instincts. You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.
  • Experience building peer networks or communities of practice. You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.

Hands-On & Technical

  • Comfortable building with AI tools. You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.
  • Ready to learn fast. Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.
  • Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.
  • Ability to map data flows - structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.

About the team

You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology & AI organization, while remaining embedded in your own function. Enterprise AI provides the technical delivery capability, platforms, and patterns. You provide the business context, prioritization, building at the no-code layer, and adoption muscle. Together, you form the core of your function's AI transformation.
